verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents first-party yield on its own operating accounts: Jeeves Cash multi-currency accounts offer "up to 5% yield", and the same digital account used to issue cards and pay bills can "earn up to 5% annually". Cash therefore earns yield where it is already held, with no move to a separate institution. missing for 10: details on how the yield works and who is eligible (rate tiers, which currencies earn it, what the asterisked conditions are), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the yield is realized on operating balances.
